_about: Members of a Discovery document that the Discovery API's own published
RestDescription schema (revision 20200806) does not declare. Each entry
records a member the documents Google serves carry, names the evidence,
and declares its type, so a served document is validated against the
contract clients read rather than merely tolerated.

_evidence: Every vendored Discovery document fetched from Google carries
the root URL google-api-go-client's generated clients switch to under
mutual TLS; compute-v1 also carries serviceVersion "v1". The
directory's getRest answers those same documents, and the schema

mtlsRootUrl.description: The root URL under which all API services live when the client uses mutual TLS.

serviceVersion.description: The version of the service the document describes.
